transcript:
Agent: AI Chauffeur, the premium reservation system for limousine, black car and chauffeured transportation. This is the demo line. Play the customer and request a trip. Calls are recorded and transcribed. Which trip would you like to try — airport, point to point, or by the hour.
User: I would like to book a ride to the airport tomorrow. 
Agent: Pickup address, pickup time, and which airport?
User: Actually, what can you do for me? I own a limo company. 
Agent: You own a limo company, got it. AI Chauffeur answers your phone line for you, twenty-four seven, taking new trip requests and sending the trip sheet to your dispatch by text and email, with the call recording and transcript. It handles one call or a thousand at once, always under your company name. What else would you like to know?
User: Does it answer under my company name? 
Agent: Yes, it answers every call under your company name, just like your own staff would. Anything else you want to know?
User: Can it send my dispatcher the trip? 
Agent: Yes, after every new trip call, your dispatcher gets the trip sheet by text and email, along with the call recording and full transcript. You can choose how you want it delivered. What else would you like to know?
User: I would like to set up a time. 
Agent: Name, company, and best number?
User: [caller], [caller]. 
Agent: That's [caller]. Is that right?
User: Yes. 
Agent: How did you hear about us?
Agent: Take your time. I'll be right here.
User: The first one, 
Agent: Okay to text the confirmation to that number?
User: Google, 
Agent: The next open times are today at 2:30 Central and today at 3 Central — which works?
User: Thanks. Goodbye. 
Agent: Thank you for calling. The site is A I chauffeur dot A I. Goodbye.
